New permission modes, a safety classifier for Auto mode, fixes for stopping the agent and for cloud-synced vaults, flat button icons and a simpler settings page.

- **Modes now work like Claude Code's permission modes.** **Manual** (the new default) asks before every note change, delete and external tool call. **Accept** writes note edits directly (you can undo them) and still asks before deletes and external tools. **Auto** sends each action to a safety classifier: actions that match your request run, and anything suspicious asks you. The classifier sees only your own messages and the actions requested, never note contents. By default it uses the chat's model; you can pick another one under Settings → Advanced options → Agent. The read-only Ask mode is gone. Existing chats are migrated: Ask and Accept become Manual, Auto becomes Accept.
- **Stop works while tools run.** Stop used to have no effect while a search was running. It now ends any running tool right away, including searching, reading, planning edits, MCP calls and connecting to MCP servers.
- **Cloud-synced vaults no longer freeze search.** In vaults on iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and similar, search no longer tries to read every note at once, which downloaded online-only notes and could freeze search and Obsidian. On desktop, notes that aren't downloaded are skipped; slow reads and a time limit cover the rest. Skipped notes are still matched by file name, path, tags, headings and properties, and the agent is told which notes were not fully searched. Reading a single note gives up after 45 seconds instead of waiting forever. The semantic index skips online-only notes too.
- **Flat design.** Send, stop, allow, reject, undo and the mode icons are flat, and buttons no longer have shadows or gradients.
- **Simpler settings.** Only providers are shown by default. Everything else is under **Advanced options**.
- The author is now shown as sigmalos.

新的权限模式、Auto 模式安全分类器、修复停止按钮和云端仓库的问题，按钮图标改为扁平风格，设置页更简洁。

- **模式改为 Claude Code 的权限模式。** **Manual**（新的默认模式）在每次修改、删除笔记或调用外部工具前都先征求你的同意。**Accept** 直接写入笔记修改（可撤销），删除和外部工具仍需确认。**Auto** 由安全分类器审查每个操作：符合你请求的直接执行，可疑的再询问你。分类器只看到你发送的消息和 Agent 请求的操作，看不到笔记内容；默认使用对话所用的模型，可在 设置 → 高级选项 → Agent 中更换。只读的 Ask 模式已移除。已有对话会自动迁移：Ask、Accept 变为 Manual，Auto 变为 Accept。
- **工具执行中也能停止。** 以前搜索进行中点停止没有反应。现在点停止会立即结束正在执行的工具，包括搜索、读取、生成修改、MCP 调用和连接 MCP 服务。
- **云端仓库搜索不再卡死。** 在 iCloud Drive、OneDrive、Dropbox 等云端同步的仓库中，搜索不再一次性读取全部笔记（这样会触发下载仅在云端的笔记，导致搜索和 Obsidian 卡死）。桌面端会跳过尚未下载的笔记，其余情况由慢读取检测和总时限兜底。跳过的笔记仍按文件名、路径、标签、标题和属性匹配，并告知 Agent 哪些笔记没有搜索正文。读取单篇笔记最多等待 45 秒，不再无限等待。语义索引同样跳过仅在云端的笔记。
- **扁平化设计。** 发送、停止、允许、拒绝、撤销以及模式图标改为扁平风格，按钮去掉阴影和渐变。
- **设置更简洁。** 默认只显示服务商配置，其余内容收在 **高级选项** 中。
- 作者名改为 sigmalos。
